Peter,
**7 weeks.** That’s all the time we have left until Election Day.
**8.** That’s how many polls show Gina neck-and-neck with Greg Abbott in a tied race for Texas Governor.
**$22 million.** That’s the amount Greg Abbott has already spent on television ads and negative attacks to tear down Gina and protect his hold on power.

That endorsement isn't just an honor. It's a call to action. President Trump is with me in this fight, and he's counting on us to stop South Carolina from sending the most extreme Democrat in the country to the United States Senate. I intend to earn every vote because that's what this job demands, and that's what South Carolina deserves. I'm ready for the fight, and I'm all in for the United States Senate. But Hollywood and liberal donors from all over the country are lining up to turn South Carolina blue. We must stop the blue wave from coming into South Carolina. My opponent has already raised $13 million, and President Trump and I need you by my side to close that gap. She has the national Democrat machine behind her. No one in South Carolina has fought harder to push gender transition procedures on confused kids than she has. Gun control. Government-run health care. Abortion up until the moment of birth. This agenda is not right for South Carolina. We’re running out of time to combat this agenda. We have less than 8 weeks left before Election Day. Every dollar raised between now and November 3rd determines whether we can compete on the airwaves, get out the vote, and win. There is no "catching up later." This is the moment. FROM: Willis
Subject: Stop caving to Trump.

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you stand up to Donald Trump and PROTECT vote-by-mail.**

Vote-by-mail has expanded voting access to millions of Americans in rural areas, serving overseas, and in marginalized communities.

Limiting access to states who do Trump’s bidding is UNDEMOCRATIC and straight up AUTHORITARIAN!

The Postal Service is a vital institution that has done so much good for our country — **so please don’t sacrifice everything you stand for now.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you stand up to Trump and this disgusting attack on voting rights. Peter,

**[I’m about to ask you to chip in $20 between Blue Amp Action and my campaign to join our team – but first I want to explain why this race is so important.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16163?t=4&akid=3080%2E259176%2EL-CxUC)**

As a pediatrician, I’ve cared for thousands of children and their families. I’ve seen the relief of parents who know their kids are protected -- and the fear when preventable diseases spread.

That’s why I dedicated my career to ensuring every child has access to lifesaving care. I co-founded a nonprofit that helped 65,000 children get health coverage. In the state legislature, we cut the number of uninsured Californians by more than half.

**Then came the Disneyland measles outbreak.**

Families were scared. Doctors were overwhelmed. Kids who should have been safe were put at risk.

So I acted. I introduced legislation to ensure every child could safely attend school, but RFK Jr. and the anti-vaccine movement mobilized to stop us. They spread lies and threats, even targeting my family.

But I refused to back down. We stood with parents, doctors, and public health leaders -- and we won. Vaccination rates rose, schools stayed safe, and California hasn’t had a major measles outbreak since.

**Now those same lies are spreading across the country -- this time from inside the government itself. RFK Jr. is using his platform to put families at risk, while MAGA Republicans in Congress work to rip away health care from millions.**

I became a doctor to heal people.

I served in office to protect them.

And I’m running for Congress now because families deserve leaders guided by science, empathy, and courage -- not fear and misinformation.

## Middle East Instability Drives Gas Prices Higher
Saudi Arabia [_closed a critical oil pipeline_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAQBeDT2B0WHhwbCopt3GXbLS0wQzy7GCxDgnL7lSPlBH87Iz297_25L3dDgeLjt9lRF5-WiDUHLAXPJZuno4MODBQxb8_iUo0WrVmAw8i4Yr1YzFrohctgWqc9IqBoUfeTVKCEVNBuerSjsOAndFZ4cZMCpbQoufJS9tL5lvSVx1Uves6HQXXoemsQBi4AcVxlM3B0VNLZ_U0Uy4Y-vNMLz25Nexv0VsqRG_GrgbmBudbaRbtejut_XdIZXAPzTs4FZGhyaWD-6Jg5jSXDvjr2D9_sS2aBdiqZJQrMh1TZG3eMbEvPslFm5xrNTU1ihPbU7qgUAuVxagb-2A2FT7nyw01fGv4HAAD__-uPj2g) after it was struck by drones launched from Iraq on Saturday. An umbrella group of Iran-backed militias in Iraq [_denied their involvement_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7ohgAWMKimvS5dorrcVs4j1h7MMkUd7-5LzCX45GmtH3_blNN-TM5fEbVwrtvk2F3kem1qhOBz4T77xT5kLH8mxpe5dIESeQMAjphdITzo1fNBnsU7gTAemegnKjB69HD_0SlFHRGK1ma0FKsCmqQUtnvUuYDJmew7knvdJKSmP8hZKKSGCkBqJhHjsjKXHb6uXvxqUtdM-f7UX1Mm9rn8PS2n50-lcH1w6uuJ8IZ3WG2njO1MGVK_4TXLGID61UxBdOYMXIKGalrQenU_JORj94GkFrO5AlTNq5voa0vzlnPgbXGflYkfP3vf1Q2ivA_wAAAP__Po9_Uw), but Iraq’s government confirmed the attacks had originated from its territory. The pipeline strikes follow the [_Houthi’s takeover of Mokha_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdI7M4BhcuNiGLttuiQY8xLPPwQhPEuXvnxLpfcGrr3Suzvl3mS7ImbfrX7xRkLVMGz1rJhE6por3yDvvlHmjmu4Sy3ObacYJDDhtvG67CRfhB00WmxhWIqCuodD2gwffDR6aFKLtZ4sO5w4M-nUAiNAP8xlnQ-isbzi8eca3XWuMtf5EsZ2RwJoOiNwyKGsospTj9L_wJonW_CoPOk5LuTU5JJG9qu6PglHBKIkS5_zeFIx7yby8FIyRVtoqKRidGc7OGZ3KXRJXLfhFb5reyyH6I62vWPWPuYKxOULcn5wzV9cra6435M9DI7-M9gjwHQAA__8xGoKl) in Yemen on Thursday. **Whatever happened to the lie detector?** For a machine that promised to [revolutionize truth-telling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHO4yAQhJ_G7ohgIf5NQXFNulx7pUVgY_aEwYJNrLz9yacrrv_bmflGo_l1X-6eMpX1p9_Q8bMuBY-ekRnb0v0r0k47ZirY04tjPcoDH34BCZOQVii9-MD0xsX4MbonIqAe0amv2YLVs4UxORuNnbSdr1N4BK28vRoz6au2INXsYxjJnX3SKq2kNMZeMKqHRzBSA-IU5sFIjMS1XX5XKpzwmT_1je0S6jZml5j3PugfA9wGuB3Hcekbceq1kC-bX8_YALf_REGlM_GLqZYTSR8RGnquTTypdRaZUERkDFxbFw3XhiyovLGciNhr_qzN70lsPiQq-M-rTahZ2vkKAAPcxubiflDO1Kevwch185T_juZvfv128CcAAP__ryaYNw), the lie detector has had a bumpy ride from midcentury marvel to scientific punchline, and yet it refuses to go away. It started in 1921, when Berkeley police officer John Larson built the first device to track blood pressure, pulse, and respiration during questioning. His protege, Leonarde Keeler, turned it into a showpiece at the 1933 World's Fair and won courtroom testimony two years later. By midcentury, the polygraph had completely captured the public's attention. Employers gave an estimated two million tests a year. Mattel released a [_Lie Detector_ board game](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykk8uWqjoQhp8mznYvSMIlAweJeL-32nQzcYVQSBQMQhTdT39Wex5hT2pS9X2Dqvrj5XEpdamvp5WsoG9zc7xC15ZgLTTHVt4zXesaSn2FtrjbzHTXFFJ5xA72_zjsj0uOUln9gCOVvayfA2AgPei7QcgwIyHDvaKviAJGcpr5mZKYUQ_LlIbgZgCKgYSe7v_6HOYS13EoZR-QuakETB2CAXwVIupApq1pPs5GX20BefkyD2g-lKl6Zb-wtm4R4QiPEB51XfcBqXz9NhEeaftbSRBQ1_VxyLCHyOjYXjpEoqUurbkiLEQjsxJeCItSA8IiAwvKmgZhcZIVIOxrW1VgJSKR4y4x2c8nJKZ0G66I-HaIJ8T3KkHYL2RbIBJpC5UXZHmg_DzIEOEnRHibHDiHXcd_2E3VNPrfWjc1IhFcFcIe4XzLF5xzwcf5z2hz6fR8ENNktWvx3XWfkdu0Hvcv6fhQeUrndbxfx5N93C6nwTPEuvw6bcfpfiA2YpmvlK6i9u_Opq2Z1DThoZnxqajqRDT3ewJOURTnbeOPr1FQBuKwOIAeJdkseKbp3Ywvfvaa7ulT7Tris8-Rcdb12ryeovbYdhq-3PL2Us-5MPPJz_j1lbNtibCHxSI9e_mr0tl5OpsOVFp7U2-5NFrcZuY90AyYOIy-c38wMRObDudu9Dz5mpTX2J1N1ADXzn6zmMHFsNtwewtnX6KQwwl7w0m1HH9mySlNYvUZh83dT0_PuWYOvw9XMVP0caeFHg9vj81sN_8-v6HNOtgOQmdB3fUzGhcLbNufYDbUNf_deYSwFwzspX4fQFzY7pPK3d_HbSt5r-lndafLUrd-gKhzqqQu319n_zEsjz7-LwAA__9BkiBQ) in 1960. CBS debuted _To Tell the Truth_ in 1956, and famous defense attorney F. Lee Bailey even had [his own lie detector show](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFu7CAURVeDu7HggYFXUPzG3fw2pYXN85iEMZZhBmX3kbOF1PfqHOl83Ke7jynuj__-Sa6uedqplUS10jkV_wrxiAeluFPZXjXkts80-wk46BvHm5CTX2p806R8F9xKBCQ7csJYBJQWodtcQE0mKB1Wvi4IcwAyHBctvQ3Ga-yiu3gchRScK4U9BTF7AsUlEOnFMsUpxJrP_jPHvW60pu_8prNf8rNLbqv1KEz-YzAyGFtr_eoXmnP-ug4MxseZX0dhMKIxQlqpLCK3AzIYj1zqtQwoldKDMnpAoSRnMHanC0eLKcWiDVP88fQx_SrrH0u9HfwEAAD__9RNegs). Then the science caught up. Courts had been [skeptical since 1923](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O6yAcB0-Du1h82bELite4y2u3tAj8bP9XBBCQWLn9KnuFvcDMaL5u681SoLj_tw-YtqU14qwBraGs1T49ZcoIFFGPZ_PpjHfc7Sq5HC98vgi1WtfohVXbzpsNkFAdjLhOs5zVNMvuMNuo9OatGpQevPLjBI5BCFzVNliMQ0fmw-OzUIJzreceXtwtpOZKAqObmObw1FLpvxPFdmAL7_RC6V16dMEcreXK1D8mFyaX8zx7m22fys7k0lImV5lcXNojfVIvEc-SqiNEByaXnMJ7LzYfXTE-nxQC1fHKNN8flsKvov3xzMvInwAAAP__gth6cw), but the real blow landed in 2003, when a National Academy of Sciences panel found the polygraph's accuracy "well above chance, though well below perfection" and its error rate essentially unknown. CIA spy Aldrich Ames, who passed two polygraphs while committing espionage, didn't help. Still, the machine never disappeared. Congress banned most private employer testing in 1988, but the FBI, CIA, NSA, and the Pentagon can still require polygraphs for security investigations. And you can see it used in scenes like this one from _Meet the Parents_ , where it's more often played for laughs rather than thrills. On the other hand, newer alternatives, including brain imaging, AI, and eye-tracking, have fared no better. The scientific consensus remains that there is no machine that can reliably detect lies. _Ever taken a lie detector test? How did it go? Hit reply and tell us._

For a machine that promised to , the lie detector has had a bumpy ride from midcentury marvel to scientific punchline, and yet it refuses to go away. It started in 1921, when Berkeley police officer John Larson built the first device to track blood pressure, pulse, and respiration during questioning. His protege, Leonarde Keeler, turned it into a showpiece at the 1933 World's Fair and won courtroom testimony two years later. By midcentury, the polygraph had completely captured the public's attention. Employers gave an estimated two million tests a year. Mattel released a in 1960. CBS debuted To Tell the Truth in 1956, and famous defense attorney F. Lee Bailey even had . Then the science caught up. Courts had been , but the real blow landed in 2003, when a National Academy of Sciences panel found the polygraph's accuracy "well above chance, though well below perfection" and its error rate essentially unknown. CIA spy Aldrich Ames, who passed two polygraphs while committing espionage, didn't help. Still, the machine never disappeared. Congress banned most private employer testing in 1988, but the FBI, CIA, NSA, and the Pentagon can still require polygraphs for security investigations. And you can see it used in scenes like this one from Meet the Parents , where it's more often played for laughs rather than thrills. On the other hand, newer alternatives, including brain imaging, AI, and eye-tracking, have fared no better. The scientific consensus remains that there is no machine that can reliably detect lies. clean_body: Let me explain why I am only asking for $5 | Fellow Patriot - Let me explain why. We just won two elections in two weeks. The special, then the runoff. It worked - but it emptied our account. Winning a runoff doesn't put a dollar back in the bank. Annie Andrews has $4.1 million. She's raised nearly $11 million from liberal donors nationwide while we fought a two-round primary just to get on the ballot. I promised South Carolina I'd carry the conservative agenda to the Senate for six more years. President Trump stood with me and told you why he trusts me, too. I'm not letting her bank account break that promise. The general is November 3 - less than 65 days out. Every week from now until then, she's on TV, in your mailbox, on your phone. We can't answer that with an empty account. I need you in the next 48 hours. Don't let the most radical candidate South Carolina Democrats have ever nominated buy this seat. ## Round Rock Park Killing Called Random
Williamson County deputies have [charged a 26-year-old man with murder](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2y4yAMhZ8Gd2RAEAMFxTbu7rZbegQoCeMfMpjYydvvOK9wS400n853_v2MP5jnvN7_4kK-vW9lXOnYZmqN6ljLa021xOmJdZryfB42fFcaQUDPheNSjRhb3mnU2CUfRHKyIy-NdeCMlqJ7-AQKwWJSoCgECgLwdiVt3VUlY1zosj9xwkklpVBgL0macBNXNKBVT0YxLSjlVuqlPajRG7fb_Ck71UssSzf7R2vPjak_DAYGw3Ecl2l_0blkMGBtOc7EYDjNGAyx5uUcH2XJMSfied1pa_mOLZeVH6cnLltZeSyvtX349yODAXrHrYw2JHAcrQauY9Dc9S5yjBajUrrvCbrq0_OL2XrDtLgvmOdv1PbbincP_wMAAP__3x2RFw) in the stabbing death of an Austin engineer on a Round Rock park bench. [Andrew James Wimsatt](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0QwOHYoKLahe9tuaWEYx8g2WDAv8fv7FfmF185cXd1z_n1NXy7uMT3_ugMNXUueEr7rjkRYppK_UyjZb6cr2xb3FiR3FZxAwMCF5lJNzlN84dS7LphZBC07NHJ8aNBjL0W3GqHvC4w4O_Dao5sDSjEoPfuH8gHuvoum1QktlZRCweMW5Dgv4u5G6NWAo2K9wBAplxutSHi5uuw_-YXl5vPR7WYlOitTfxhYBjb9nLlSezGwrZmBFZqBlcDAflfeCBlYTM-YEAt_R1q533NFThErp8yXfH1ifM2VKm_sGHhMvLgU8sEdkfNbO3zm8IJnLsTAdsWE891U1WFkvXgeLu6fmfRbvS8D_wMAAP__3puRoQ), 62, had just visited his mother at a nearby nursing home when he was attacked shortly before 11 a.m. on Sept. 7. A witness found his body at Chandler Creek Park. A homeowners association camera captured the attack. Detectives [canvassed a nearby McDonald's](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DuOgzAQxvHTmM7Ir2AoXGxDl223RAMeJ1YMjszw2NuvyBW2_2tGv-_nPtwhprg8vmFGR2fIw4LHmpAIy1DytviSp9cbyusV0xUSnAUHJVTDRcelHmCiuONgoPJuFL6TFTpp20511khRPd10k60eTbiJBmRrpFeNbnw7dlLb1mtfRXedE53UUgqt2tpLOwZxA6uMbtBqZgT6SLnU9ETCE9aQfvOOpZ7yXCX3JHqvTH8x1TPVH8dRh3xa2FaKy5Uw1V8qpvqPiF8kPm_FY-EQQvSwR-ILHtwjQUxrVZx_Hxd4bSwz4jFDTJ9n9N-Rdqf-AgAA__-CZn4Z), traced a red SUV to a family home less than a mile away, and arrested Benedict Chinedu Ogbodiegwu. The sheriff's office says the two men did not know each other. Ogbodiegwu faces [murder and theft charges](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGurCAURb9GOyZwQNHC4jV297WvNEc43CEiTAB17t-_OL9wy529s5K1_30tX-iDj99_caepvl1aIl0lUK2Ul5yOaHMy2wvztvlwDyu-My3AoWd8ZEIuaKo_aVHY2mnldhQtTUIPI4xaCd4-JwBE15HWoutBKG6I1hHXrlMrd6tzrZ9uHB-FFIJLGB5W6NXxDjUo2ZOWjeJkfU35UZ9U6Y3FhZ90Un6YtLdhetb6Ko3808DcwHxd12M7D7rLBmbM1ZtADcy3WQOzyX6_o03m2CnWwsqRT_IhYDTETm8psS16RwxzplLZdavjXlJkJh2x_rBn2r3x9sZAPzLNBwXCEJM9GKas6NkgnWNoFHEnRCcH1ebJvj6k0utG8e8dffgI1N8ef07wPwAA__9VaZlD) and is held on $1 million bond. His Williamson County record dates to 2017, and he was released from the county jail in June. The Texas Rangers are assisting.

**Peter** , I flew above battlefields, passing burning husks of armored vehicles, and in Iraq I poured enough sand out of my boots to fill a desert. You would think that after flying an Apache helicopter through an active war zone, and having God knows how many stray bullets shot my direction, there’s not a thing on this planet that could scare me.
I thought so too, _until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the _**next few days.**__

Let me explain. This campaign’s bigger than anything I’ve done in Iraq. Rather than covering for a team on the ground, the fate of** more than 10 million people** will be decided in November. Campaigning isn’t easy, and sometimes it feels like the weight of the world is on my shoulders. **Just before I typed this email, my team reminded me about our upcoming _End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline._** This isn’t just an arbitrary deadline; this is one of our last BIG goals before the November election. I thought so too, until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the next few days. Let me explain. This campaign’s bigger than anything I’ve done in Iraq. Campaigning isn’t easy, and sometimes it feels like the weight of the world is on my shoulders. Just before I typed this email, my team reminded me about our upcoming End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline. This isn’t just an arbitrary deadline; this is one of our last BIG goals before the November election. I’m not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I’m asking is a $1 or more donation, which will go right into my campaign's war chest and help me and President Trump take down the Democrat machine come November. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3085%2E259176%2EBJOffF) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3085%2E259176%2EBJOffF)_

Peter, I'm reaching out with a personal request:

**[Will you donate $24, split between Blue Amp Action and me, to our work to flip the Senate and finally hold Trump to account?](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16169?t=4&akid=3085%2E259176%2EBJOffF)** | [DONATE $24 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16170?t=5&akid=3085%2E259176%2EBJOffF)
---
We have an opportunity this November to change the course of our country.

Control of the Senate comes down to a net gain of four seats. Republicans know it as well as we do, and they are not planning to hold their majority by virtue of their policies and arguments. _They are planning to outspend us_.

Dark money donors. Handpicked self-funders. Super PACs behind every vulnerable Republican on the map. All to hold onto their Senate majority.

And we know what a Republican majority does with its oversight power, because we have watched it sit unused for two years. They will do nothing.

The president has personally taken in billions since taking office, and this Senate has not asked him or his cronies a single question about it under oath. He has gone after the machinery of our elections, and this Senate has called it overreach to object. A Senate that will not use its subpoena power is a Senate that has decided the president answers to no one.

We must flip four seats to take power, and there are eight places to get them — North Carolina, Ohio, Maine, Alaska, Iowa, Florida, Mississippi and Texas. Every one is winnable and not one is safe.

A year ago, most people looking at this map would have said we had a brutal path. That changed because candidates decided to run in states that were not supposed to be competitive.

**[Our ability to hold Trump accountable depends on a Democratic Senate majority. So I am humbly asking you to please chip in $24 to Blue Amp Action and me to help us win the seats we need to flip the Senate →](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16169?t=6&akid=3085%2E259176%2EBJOffF)**

— Adam

name: Cooper HQ
subject: Looking for 10 people from your area
body:
Our deadline is coming up.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1335&source=&t=1&akid=3491%2E124072%2EEWQwLX) | | | |
---
Peter,
We’re not relying on megadonors swooping in to save us with massive checks when we’re in trouble with our fundraising goals. No, that’s our MAGA opponent, Michael Whatley.
**We’re counting on people like you chipping in what you can, when you can – and right now, we need you.**
The GOP is going all in to defeat Roy and crush our grassroots movement. Super PACs are investing over $100 million to run baseless attack ads trying to turn voters against us, and we’re in dire need of more resources to fight back and run new ads of our own.
That’s why we set a goal to raise $2.5 million before the mid-month deadline on Tuesday at midnight. That’s why we’re reaching out to top supporters like you, Peter.
**Here’s our plan: If just 10 people from your area chip in $5 to this email, we'll be on track meet our goal and surge ahead in this statistically tied race. We know not everyone can or will donate today, so we’re counting on YOU to be one of the 10.**
[**_Peter, will you represent your area with a $5 donation? If you care about flipping North Carolina and taking back the Senate for Democrats, we’re relying on your support right now._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1335&amount=5&t=8&akid=3491%2E124072%2EEWQwLX)

Team Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1335&source=&t=3&akid=3491%2E124072%2EEWQwLX)

She was rescued. Many are still waiting. You can help find them.

| | |

| |

| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,A little girl sat alone in the dark. Lured online by someone pretending to care and taken from her home. Kidnapped and hidden away in a remote cabin, where she was abused, and sold online. And passed from one man to another. **Her name is Alice. **
---
[ Rescue A Child Now](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-O4yAMxp-G3FIBpkk45LDaqtIeZq57RK5xGjQBukA6r7_KTJ9gbv73fT_Z_vvm3jBsId3fMfJMz-BKdUhr2Pwn1oYfnNrKqebIbQ1OSz300vYKHFILT3YGOz-TH0B3PKtxstpaC1O3zjdjlFVyHEZLoM-WtVVMlsgyLNJzF-bDTloFSpkznE-THpGlUQrOejDKCyP3h8fG9UQ5VS5PPJghpXxEOZ0ox26b19YeVcAvoa9CXyvTXvhU8558XpbC7HNcjuxbk8td6CvI27SAx94P8twbPXF_Mwv0g74pT6zGxaOAa817IXaUPQu4_P7zrsBYsEIPe4susg97FHDhiGF7Fb8lAi4rFo_1wyH9e7UI4wPDPQm41Lw43AJx4Uo7f132NdW4HJ5dmf3jM2xbqMMojLwfjK-N2w8f9Zz1_wAAAP__mNakRw)
---
And this is the part most people never hear. **She was found. An investigator in Florida traced her trafficker's username. He saw a connection others missed and contacted the FBI. **Agents followed the digital trail, tracing the trafficker's **IP address**. They moved in, raided the location and rescued her. **Alive.**
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-O4yAMxp-G3FIBpkk45LDaqtIeZq57RK5xGjQBukA6r7_KTJ9gbv73fT_Z_vvm3jBsId3fMfJMz-BKdUhr2Pwn1oYfnNrKqebIbQ1OSz300vYKHFILT3YGOz-TH0B3PKtxstpaC1O3zjdjlFVyHEZLoM-WtVVMlsgyLNJzF-bDTloFSpkznE-THpGlUQrOejDKCyP3h8fG9UQ5VS5PPJghpXxEOZ0ox26b19YeVcAvoa9CXyvTXvhU8558XpbC7HNcjuxbk8td6CvI27SAx94P8twbPXF_Mwv0g74pT6zGxaOAa817IXaUPQu4_P7zrsBYsEIPe4susg97FHDhiGF7Fb8lAi4rFo_1wyH9e7UI4wPDPQm41Lw43AJx4Uo7f132NdW4HJ5dmf3jM2xbqMMojLwfjK-N2w8f9Zz1_wAAAP__mNakRw)
---
Her trafficker now faces **20 years to life** in prison. This is what happens when someone goes looking.
This is what happens when the right tools are in place. But there are still so many children who have not been found yet. Still waiting.
Still trapped.
---
[ Rescue A Child Now](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc-O4yAMxp-G3FIBpkk45LDaqtIeZq57RK5xGjQBukA6r7_KTJ9gbv73fT_Z_vvm3jBsId3fMfJMz-BKdUhr2Pwn1oYfnNrKqebIbQ1OSz300vYKHFILT3YGOz-TH0B3PKtxstpaC1O3zjdjlFVyHEZLoM-WtVVMlsgyLNJzF-bDTloFSpkznE-THpGlUQrOejDKCyP3h8fG9UQ5VS5PPJghpXxEOZ0ox26b19YeVcAvoa9CXyvTXvhU8558XpbC7HNcjuxbk8td6CvI27SAx94P8twbPXF_Mwv0g74pT6zGxaOAa817IXaUPQu4_P7zrsBYsEIPe4susg97FHDhiGF7Fb8lAi4rFo_1wyH9e7UI4wPDPQm41Lw43AJx4Uo7f132NdW4HJ5dmf3jM2xbqMMojLwfjK-N2w8f9Zz1_wAAAP__mNakRw)
---
And that is why the **Sound of Freedom Foundation **exists. Friend, if this is your first time hearing about us, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation 's **mission is clear: **_To stop the sale of God 's children._** The foundation extends the reach of the _Sound of Freedom_ film, bringing awareness to the reality of child trafficking and taking action to stop it. Our vision is simple: **_A world where every child is safe and free._** We work with partners to prevent exploitation before it begins, support rescue operations, and equip investigators. Our partners walk with survivors as they heal and rebuild their lives. Because rescue is only the beginning. And right now, there is an urgent need. We are launching **_Operation Search and Rescue, _**a _ _ mission to connect investigators and agents, identify traffickers, and build criminal evidence.

We will support real rescue operations using tools like **digital tracking and face recognition**. This is how children are found and how traffickers are stopped.
And today, you can be part of it. **And right now, your donation will be matched, dollar for dollar.****A concerned Child Defense Organization** **has approved** **a** **$10,000 MATCHING GRANT**.

We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. This exact situation happened in Wisconsin last year when Elon Musk dumped $20 million to influence one single supreme court race. It’s happening again in Ohio right now. **A billionaire, from Pennsylvania no less, has already spent ten figures and counting to support former-DOGE boss Vivek Ramaswamy in the governor’s race.** That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. _Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio?_ Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. That's why we’ve endorsed Democracy Defender candidates in these races. [**We need your help to ensure no one gets away with buying their way into power. We can’t compete with million-dollar checks, but grassroots support adds up fast. clean_body: The power of the people, not the billionaires, must be heard in November. | We've seen this exact playbook before, Peter. Republicans see an election that will have huge implications on their ability to rig political maps — so they wrangle their billionaire buddies to try to buy the seat. This exact situation happened in Wisconsin last year when Elon Musk dumped $20 million to influence one single supreme court race. It’s happening again in Ohio right now. A billionaire, from Pennsylvania no less, has already spent ten figures and counting to support former-DOGE boss Vivek Ramaswamy in the governor’s race. That's more than Democrat Amy Acton has raised from all of her donors combined. Why is all of this investment happening in Ohio? Because with a win for governor, anti-democracy forces can fill a key seat on the state's redistricting commission — an entity that has enabled Republican gerrymandering in the past. Wins in the governor, auditor, and secretary of state races could swing this commission and make a path to fairer maps possible. That's why we’ve endorsed Democracy Defender candidates in these races. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = The good news is that we know voters can’t stand it when the powerful elite try to purchase a political race. That helped us defeat Elon Musk in Wisconsin last year. It’s no accident that the right-wing billionaires are targeting the races that will have the most impact on the future fights over democracy. The NDRC has identified over 250 critical elections, and we’re doing everything we can to elect Democracy Defenders in as many of these races as possible. We can win this critical election even if we're outspent, but we can't let Amy Acton get drowned out completely. = Thank you, National Democratic Redistricting Committee = = | | Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President. | | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|---|--- National Democratic Redistricting Committee 712 H St NE, #25 Washington, DC 20002 United States if you'd like to receive fewer emails from the NDRC. The Daily Caller News Foundation's September 3 report, "How the Left Is Taking Over America's Reddest State," describes exactly what happened in Wyoming's August 18 primary. There was no Democratic wave -- none was needed. What occurred instead was a well-funded machine of donors, business interests, and establishment PACs running left-leaning Republicans behind conservative branding, and winning decisively.
**The Machine Worked**
In July, the PAC Common Sense Republicans for Wyoming released a 2026 Republican Primary Voter Guide endorsing Eric Barlow for governor, Robert Short for secretary of state, and three House candidates running against sitting Freedom Caucus members. Co-founder Emily Madden touted that 29 of the PAC's 34 endorsed candidates won their races. Barlow crushed Trump-backed Megan Degenfelder, 45.1% to 29.7%, and Short won as well. In America's reddest state, the primary is the election -- and the left-of-center faction just captured it.
**Branding vs. Record**
The article's most important point concerns how this victory was sold. Barlow's campaign presented him as a "mainstream conservative Republican." His legislative record tells a different story. As the Freedom Caucus has documented, Barlow consistently supported ever-growing state spending, voted against state sovereignty measures, sponsored progressive legislation, and as Speaker presided over the 2020 special session during Gov. Gordon's COVID lockdowns -- a session that failed to protect the rights of the people of Wyoming. That is not a conservative record; it is a big-government record wearing a cowboy hat.
**The Money Trail**
Barlow's campaign shattered Wyoming fundraising records, raising more than $1.65 million -- fueled by a coalition of donors, business groups, and PACs united less by conservative principle than by opposition to the Freedom Caucus. The PAC's own literature attacked Freedom Caucus funding as "out of state," yet the coalition financing Barlow and his allies was itself a national-scale operation. Money beat message, and the "common sense" label did the rest.
**What Wyoming Lost**
The stakes were real. Wyoming's Freedom Caucus was the first in the nation to hold a majority in a statehouse, and it delivered: a steep property tax cut, a ban on diversity programs in government, and most of its legislative priorities enacted. Those achievements came from legislators who answered to voters, not to chambers of commerce. Now many of those members have lost their seats to better-funded opponents, and Wyoming's policy direction will shift accordingly -- toward higher spending, softer conservatism, and an establishment comfortable with the status quo.
**The Lesson**
Nicole Silverio's closing warning is the one conservatives everywhere should heed. The Wyoming playbook -- rebrand moderates as "mainstream conservatives," outspend the grassroots in primaries, and let the deep-red general election do the rest -- is fully portable to any Republican state. If conservatives sit out primaries, cede the airwaves, and let coalition money define the terms, they will lose their states without ever seeing a Democrat's name on the winning ballot. Wyoming proves the strategy works. The question is whether other red states will wake up in time.
The Daily Caller report is accurate, timely, and necessary. Wyoming's takeover wasn't hidden -- it was simply laundered through Republican labels (NERINO TM). Agreeing with the article isn't optional for anyone who watched the results; it's the only honest reading of them.

Derek, have you heard the news?
I’m teaming up with the Democratic National Committee to bring a grassroots supporter like _you_ to Washington, DC for a personal tour of one of my very favorite spots here — the Air and Space Museum.
**[DONATE $7, or ANY AMOUNT, TO ENTER](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-Kelly-sweepstakes-2026?refcode=em_20260913_9093_fr&amount=7&refcode2=9093_22930333_iiz5ui&akid=9093%2E22930333%2Eiiz5ui)**

clean_body: Annie Andrews is the most radical Democrat South Carolina has ever nominated. President Trump and I need you to step up. | Peter, President Trump encouraged me to run. That endorsement isn't just an honor. It's a call to action. President Trump is with me in this fight, and he's counting on us to stop South Carolina from sending the most extreme Democrat in the country to the United States Senate. I intend to earn every vote because that's what this job demands, and that's what South Carolina deserves. I'm ready for the fight, and I'm all in for the United States Senate. But Hollywood and liberal donors from all over the country are lining up to turn South Carolina blue. We must stop the blue wave from coming into South Carolina. My opponent has already raised $13 million, and President Trump and I need you by my side to close that gap. She has the national Democrat machine behind her. What I don't have in war chests, Annie Andrews backs ALL of the Democrats’ radical agenda. No one in South Carolina has fought harder to push gender transition procedures on confused kids than she has. Gun control. Government-run health care. Abortion up until the moment of birth. This agenda is not right for South Carolina. We’re running out of time to combat this agenda. We have less than 8 weeks left before Election Day. Every dollar raised between now and November 3rd determines whether we can compete on the airwaves, get out the vote, and win. There is no "catching up later." This is the moment. body:
If you are having trouble viewing this email, [click here.](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/preview/127/71965/3d17bb08bc58047540eaab87595d1e7deec2ab54?message_id=IjkzYjRmNmEwLTkxYzItMDEzZi04MmY0LTFhYTczZmI0MmM4MUB0aGVwcmlja2x5cGVhci5vcmci)

| | |
---
| | | [](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/127/71965/dfa6ef12fcddd44cbc10991ab0d55575fb3fb38d/3d17bb08bc58047540eaab87595d1e7deec2ab54)
---
| | | **If the midterm argument is really about your wallet, the numbers aren't close.**
* **19.2% vs. 7.8%.** Cumulative inflation: Biden versus Trump.
* **41% higher.** Avg. gas prices under Biden versus Trump. Peaked at $5.01 per gallon.
* **$1,200 to $2,000.** What the typical household loses every year if the Trump tax cuts were allowed to expire.
* **12%** : How much stock market growth under Biden lagged behind Trump’s first term.
* **Net total energy exporter:** Under Trump, the United States reached this status for the first time in 67 years.

You pulled up to the pump this week and watched the number climb past where it should be. A tariff fight with Canada reads more like a family feud than foreign policy. The Oval Office has gone gold, and somebody decided the Kennedy Center needed a facelift. You are allowed to be annoyed.

But do not confuse annoyance with danger. **Gold trim is temporary. A worldview is not.

** Every election comes down to one question: the vision, not the man. **Which side is more likely to advance my prosperity and my security?** That is the whole ballot. Everything else is window dressing.

**_It's not just what their leaders say out loud. It is that their voters actually believe it.

_**Their leaders say abolish the border. Rep. Ocasio-Cortez: "It is time to abolish ICE." Sen. Warren wants to "release every person currently detained." Tell yourself that is just one wing of the party. **Then look at the base:** 67% of progressive Democrats agree, and nearly half the party **wants no criminal penalty at all** for crossing the border illegally. **Just 22%** of Democrats and Democrat leaning voters think border security is a very important issue.

**Their representatives say the free market is the problem.** A sitting mayor wants government to "operate public food markets directly." Groceries, run by the state. **Where is their base on private property?** 77% of Democrats back a direct tax on high-net-worth individuals. Not just income. The assets you spent a lifetime building.

**Their leaders cannot tell you what a woman is.** Asked under oath, a sitting Supreme Court justice answered, "I can't. I'm not a biologist." **Then look at the base:** 63% of Democrats _**say your sex and your gender need not agree.**_ Need one more from an active member of Congress? “Gender identity is separate from biological sex... _**Reducing womanhood strictly to chromosomes or anatomy is harmful.”**_ **Rep Pramila Jayapal

** We have differences, but they want an entirely different value system. A recent poll showed 49% of Democrats reported sympathizing more with Palestinians than Israelis (38%). **Palestinians over Israelis.

****35.4% of Democrats supported reducing spending on law enforcement.** As AOC said herself, "Defunding police means defunding police.”

This is not a string of gaffes. **This is the platform, and the platform has a constituency.** The primary is where you argue with the family. **The general election is where you decide whether the family survives.

** You are not being asked to love everything. Perfect is not on the menu. You are being asked to choose one path over the other. **Which side is more likely to advance my prosperity and my security?** Facts are Prickly things, -The Editors

**What can a rugged individual do about it?
**
1. VOTE. Turnout in November. [CLICK HERE FOR A DIRECT LINK](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/127/71965/dfa6ef12fcddd44cbc10991ab0d55575fb3fb38d/3d17bb08bc58047540eaab87595d1e7deec2ab54)
2. Learn 10 solid facts about the state of American labor. [CLICK HERE FOR A DIRECT LINK](https://links.thepricklypear.org/a/2777/click/127/71965/dfa6ef12fcddd44cbc10991ab0d55575fb3fb38d/3d17bb08bc58047540eaab87595d1e7deec2ab54)
3. Forward this article/email to one person in your life who either needs to read it or wants to be armed with condensed and sourced reality.

body:
Last week, we learned that the Department of the Interior plans to break ground on Trump’s “triumphal” arch just outside the gates of Arlington later this month.
#
Peter,
My name is Karen Meredith, and I am a Gold Star mother. My son is one of more than 400,000 buried at Arlington National Cemetery.
My only child, 1LT Ken Ballard, joined the Army after graduating high school in 1995. As an Army granddaughter, Army daughter, Army sister, and Army mom, I couldn't have been more proud of his decision.
My son deployed to Iraq in May of 2003, and 384 days later he was killed while fighting an Iranian-backed militia in Najaf. He had been scheduled to return home one month earlier, but his tour was extended.
For families like mine, Arlington is more than a cemetery. It is where Ken is at eternal peace. It is a place an entire country comes to express its gratitude for a debt that cannot be repaid.
Donald Trump wants to destroy that peace. Last week, we learned that the Department of the Interior plans to break ground on Trump’s “triumphal” arch just outside the gates of Arlington later this month.
Trump never served. He called my son and all who served alongside him “suckers” and “losers." He trampled the graves of the fallen in Section 60 for a campaign photo opportunity. That same man would use their graves as the backdrop for his own vanity project.
The indignity of this arch is difficult to put into words, but I am grateful to have an outlet for resisting it in my work with VoteVets. They are building a nationwide mobilization against this arch, and I’d be grateful if you could contribute to support them.

subject: I worked in the firearms industry for over 25 years. Now, I’m working with Gabby Giffords to fight for decency and responsibility.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
I’ve had enough.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=1&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)
---
My name is Ryan Busse. For more than 25 years, I worked as a firearms executive who helped build one of the world’s most iconic gun companies.
When I first started, the gun industry was a different place. It was a place where people like me could still advocate for responsibility and decency.
But over time, I saw firsthand how the gun industry changed. It gave up its values to stoke fear and extremism. The NRA entertained dangerous conspiracy theories — including attempts to undermine our democracy.
**I had enough. Now, I am working alongside Gabby Giffords to hold the gun industry accountable and help save our country.**
[**Before I share more, can you make a donation to help GIFFORDS PAC continue their fight? The November elections are in just a few weeks, and your donations will be put to work winning the most competitive of races.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=2&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=3&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)**
Growing up on a ranch, my dad taught me to shoot at a young age. He instilled in me both a love of shooting and a deep sense of responsibility. I still shoot and hunt with my own boys any chance I get and I believe in our rights to do so.
The way I use guns hasn’t changed. What _has_ changed is the NRA.
The NRA was founded to teach firearm safety and promote hunter education. _It’s given all that up._
Now, it’s a tool for extremists to push their agenda and undermine even the most basic and commonsense regulations like background checks. They spend millions of dollars every year lobbying lawmakers to bend to their will — even though a majority of gun-owning Americans support these same commonsense solutions.
This isn’t okay. And it doesn’t have to be this way.
**Since leaving the industry, I have joined forces with Gabby Giffords to continue our fight back against the radicalization of the gun lobby.**
GIFFORDS has worked to build a national coalition of grassroots supporters committed to advancing commonsense gun safety laws. With your support, we can continue countering the NRA’s lies.
[**If you’re able, please contribute $10 or more to power GIFFORDS PAC’s work. Grassroots support makes a big difference in this work, and our fight cannot wait.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q32026.gsDos-&refcode=em260913-1-b&t=4&akid=11798%2E3935704%2EzUNqGU)

body:
A quick note about why it's so important you get involved |
#
---
Folks, I know. It's Sunday, the Lions are back, and I'd _much_ rather be talking football. **But right now, all eyes are on Michigan.** We've got some of the biggest races in the country happening right here, and national Republicans have already committed tens of millions of dollars to drown out Democratic candidates up and down the ballot. That tells you something about what the next few weeks are going to look like. **Michigan is going to be flooded with ads, spending, and national groups trying to decide our future for us.** I've won two statewide races here. Liberal Billionaires think my opponent’s poll is 100% REAL, and they’re not only unleashing the fundraising floodgates directly into this race, but they’re attacking me, my family, and ALL of MAGA to see me SURRENDER.

❌ White men are the greatest domestic terrorist threat in this country❌ God is "non-binary"
❌ The Bible is pro-abortion
❌ Christianity is "the most violent religion"
❌ There are six genders, not two That's not a caricature. That's the man in his own words. Strip away the "Christian" branding, and the policy agenda underneath is standard-issue far left: open borders, government-run healthcare, abortion up to birth, gun control, welfare for illegal immigrants, and a war on parental rights in schools.

name: Deb Haaland
subject: Do you believe in my vision for New Mexico?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5298?refcode=jtk1311-su-nd&t=1&akid=12351%2E400544%2EV3dr-S)
---
Friend: In a moment, I'm going to share with you my vision for New Mexico — **_[but first, can I ask you to take 30 seconds to personally endorse my campaign for Governor?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202609_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk1311-su-nd&refcode=jtk1311-su-nd&t=2&akid=12351%2E400544%2EV3dr-S)_**
| | [Add My Name](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202609_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk1311-su-nd&refcode=jtk1311-su-nd&t=3&akid=12351%2E400544%2EV3dr-S)
---
This message is a bit on the longer side, but because you're invested in the future of New Mexico, I hope you'll take the time to read my plan. **As New Mexico’s next Governor, I will:**
**Build Education That Works for New Mexico by:**
* Ensuring students can read before third grade by identifying literacy challenges early and providing targeted support when children fall behind

* Strengthening early literacy screening, expanding bilingual and reading instruction, and investing in summer reading and after-school programs that reinforce learning beyond the school day

* Bolstering access to universal childcare, because learning begins long before a child enters a classroom

* Directing unspent dollars from the Public School Capital Outlay Fund to modernize and improve school facilities so kids can focus on learning

* Expanding outdoor and place-based learning through my Every Child Outdoor Initiative, giving schools the tools and resources to connect classroom instruction to real-world learning that improves engagement and outcomes

**Support New Mexico Families by:**
* Raising the minimum wage and eliminating predatory junk fees

* Passing Paid Family and Medical Leave so people don’t have to choose between caring for their family and making ends meet

* Increasing the child tax credit to put money back into your pockets

* Creating a statewide tenant bill of rights to make renting more affordable and more transparent

* Creating a Critical Sector Housing Fund for workers in critical sectors — like healthcare, behavioral health, social work, education, and more — to recruit more professionals to New Mexico to address endemic shortages that hold our people back

* Aggressively building more housing, eliminating unnecessary red tape, driving state investment into housing, and shortening the time it takes to build a home — and ensuring those homes are built with New Mexican labor

**Back Small Businesses by:**
* Establishing a permanent Office of Small Business to coordinate development programs, fill gaps left by federal cuts, and provide clear access to grants, capital, and state resources

* Cracking down on predatory lending by requiring full transparency in small-business loan disclosures

* Establishing a New Mexico Economic Growth Trust Fund to stabilize our economy in the face of federal uncertainty

**Fix Our Broken Healthcare System by:**
* Protecting and expanding access to healthcare in every part of New Mexico

* Banning medical debt from being included on credit reports

* Expanding New Mexico’s Health Care Affordability Fund to protect access for those who rely on the state marketplace

* Using budget surpluses to fill Medicaid gaps and hire more guides to help people enroll in and keep their benefits

* Ensuring sustainable funding for rural hospitals and clinics, expanding mobile health clinics, and significantly increasing access to outpatient behavioral and mental health care, including a full-scale effort to deliver mental health and homelessness assistance statewide

**Strengthen Public Safety by:**
* Ensuring that law enforcement has the tools, staffing, and technology they need to do their jobs effectively

* Investing in mental and behavioral healthcare and housing stability

* Expanding violence intervention and prevention programs in schools and communities, building accountability systems that emphasize fairness and trust, and investing in community policing models that supplement traditional police work

* Creating a statewide Department of Community Safety staffed with social workers and counselors so law enforcement can focus on violent crime while people get the help they need

* Requiring ICE agents to clearly identify themselves and prohibiting masks that shield misconduct from accountability

New Mexico deserves steady leadership that’s ready on day one, leadership rooted in firsthand knowledge and experience. But the only way we'll be able to make this vision a reality is with strong grassroots support from people like you.
**I'm aiming to get 10,000 endorsements for my campaign before my midnight deadline to show the grassroots strength behind my vision for New Mexico, and I want you to be one of them._[Will you please take a quick moment to sign on now?](https://act.debhaaland.com/signup/em_mw_202609_endorse_vision?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&ask=5&source=jtk1311-su-nd&refcode=jtk1311-su-nd&t=4&akid=12351%2E400544%2EV3dr-S)_**

Thank you for your support,

Deb

_Nadia was only 15 years old when they went looking for her. _ A pastor had called House Parent Project, a children's home in Mexico. He knew Nadia was in danger. He even knew the Metro station in Mexico City where she could often be found.So the house parents went and they found her. But to understand what happened next, you need to know where Nadia came from. She never knew her father. Her mother lived an unstable and dangerous life, moving from one man to another. Nadia was the oldest of three little girls. Her youngest sister was given up for adoption. But Nadia grew up with almost nothing and no one. She survived on the streets of Mexico City, surrounded by drugs, prostitution, abandonment, and exploitation. Imagine being 15 years old and wondering if there is a single adult in this world you can trust. That was the girl they found near that Metro station. There was doubt in Nadia's eyes. But they asked her to give them a chance.
---
[ Help Feed And Protect A Child](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=f7539ddb358243e4a91edbef87131cca&_e=cJEnUj1iJhY_Eg5XRhN2SuW9S0DymFyeSsahBDPf_FJeX31nyOJXmmG6oi-3CSz8AqQhp8TFZYjEy0q0Vcfnajvnt6cpQrILj3hYSH5b0AjO8PX8RQh8Ybwdq0fDED1pMgntjEI90a-gV0Mc6zNmlpLtR7C7pOzW5PKZHnx1_MRTU7Ip6Y9ekHKKGGaAc7ue61y-f-umEcDutSDu1HGNszOw0EjHT26W8UYgdYLiCIl4OFNecH_KlFQZQ1IqNmwRAW96pc0OOiKtWy2Ovh7gQAAvQl7mDrJptC-mh43vgAkvor3ZHBUMxBJ0MM4RnhmG8OFFrDQoqywVKuABZ7KnHUZhGSE1mdmtSXqmpKcJByfIRPAoG9LzYwHy-9UGMKTtbrB-AqzZhnJ-krSUIwkvuOde3E4sCfeouijO8IDlZt2uFNCnVtVH2nZErN7Vz_Iiq0eXATuUXvk1TCm62exd2CQm0r3-47IISyO7ujbO7QYgKZ5mhuU_fQEW36DKzlTmB7DkpYBoyzl1NYihOWMjALW58yJoOUVMLN3YIWuhcZRJpX6T06epUSxU0M6U0Z7plblSPNOT5JUNVYQWz9dm1Whik3OnW9nXxPlohzsffjbRLqCt2byoBkmrh-jJl64bArCF6v8BQ893e-CytZ9tJdkw4LgldpghJ2_Hh6GkO7c%3D)

They told her something every child deserves to hear: **You are loved. **They promised to protect her and help her get an education. And Nadia willingly went with them. She left behind a horrible life and came home to parents who would raise her as their own. Friend, Nadia's story is one reason **Sound of Freedom Foundation** works with groups like House Parent Project.My name is Eduardo Verastegui. I produced the movie _Sound of Freedom_ because after learning what traffickers do to innocent children, I could not simply look away.For me, it stopped being a movie. It became a calling. Today, the **Sound of Freedom Foundation** carries that mission forward. Our mission is simple: **Stop the sale of God 's children.** House Parent Project shares that commitment. Their house parents give these children the love and care they've never known.
---
[ Help Feed And Protect A Child](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=f7539ddb358243e4a91edbef87131cca&_e=cJEnUj1iJhY_Eg5XRhN2SuW9S0DymFyeSsahBDPf_FJeX31nyOJXmmG6oi-3CSz8AqQhp8TFZYjEy0q0Vcfnajvnt6cpQrILj3hYSH5b0AjO8PX8RQh8Ybwdq0fDED1pMgntjEI90a-gV0Mc6zNmlpLtR7C7pOzW5PKZHnx1_MRTU7Ip6Y9ekHKKGGaAc7ue61y-f-umEcDutSDu1HGNszOw0EjHT26W8UYgdYLiCInyQIvuex12MAdSWahACrr8G0dvlk2x35N2rs2REvWJIcGfpYSK7N4jvjeAaZORQB9RCjzCWHUmfjm2hiDSw4ZUdxIKxhbEgG4KEluLGlsxBhSBRFs1vttdBcwygBjxvEE6ulux8XP6AaKgCZ7lJBgJAuc3UQ9-32qrwLmPa_Q8ScoxdXWwwSyrSr4OSo2yYvTFc1kYma5JZPU3INN8pYCpVg4TAWm-rTXLBdkZVs3S8eY5CFRGQSTbG3V7NJvRZXRMg-OkZSYV_exyYe2HqD1eBfRx7ulfP0e2rFT-Q-XhaPq_-R8KfOR7xxFSok9qwUGCarHOHXJpCsGg25V-oroKzgnPU77VwM-UHwu3IDO3twZmnh3lU9wNeBxXwfH6tJQbyj1dJ8A7Pp2nl2nisvl_cBDDlLXA185pHbszg_o0gpFu3jHrhImf4u6aY6cwFeY%3D)

And Nadia shows what can happen when a child is not abandoned. A couple of years after her rescue, the team found Nadia's sister, Sofia. She was suffering through many of the same horrors. They rescued her too. Today, Sofia works full time caring for other children who have experienced the same kinds of brokenness. Then something beautiful happened in Nadia's life. She met Joseph, who had also grown up in the same Village - the House Parent Project community. They fell in love. They married, Joseph became a foreman, and the couple moved away for several years. They welcomed a son and daughter of their own. Yet they kept coming back for Christmas, Mother's Day, and birthdays. **Their hearts were still with the children. **Finally, in 2019, Nadia and Joseph came home permanently. Today, **they are second in command at one of the large children 's homes**. The child who once needed someone to find her**grew up to help care for children who need to be found. **That is**restoration**. That is **hope**. And that is why I am writing to you. clean_body: Don’t let Washington use your own paycheck to build a digital fence around your life.| | | RECORD STATUS:OPEN FOR VOTING LEGISLATION IN FOCUS: H.R. 10221 (THE FLOCK-OFF ACT) The government is treating YOU like a common criminal. Right now, AI cameras are quietly scanning your license plate, tracking your family’s location, and uploading your private daily routes directly to government cloud servers. And the ultimate insult?YOU are the one paying for it, Peter. The Swamp is taking your hard-earned tax dollars and handing them directly to private camera vendors like Flock to erect an unhinged digital fence around your life. Every driver in America is being swept up in a warrantless dragnet — funded entirely by the victims themselves. This is an outrageous betrayal of the Fourth Amendment, and it makes my blood boil. Which is why Congressman Thomas Massie and I fired back with a groundbreaking legislative strike:The Flock-Off Act (H.R. 10221). Our bill delivers an uncompromising ultimatum to D.C. bureaucrats :If an agency receives a single dime of federal taxpayer money, they CANNOT use it to buy, operate, or maintain warrantless ALPR cameras or biometric surveillance grids. Period. The Fourth Amendment is NOT** negotiable. Modern technology doesn’t give the federal government a free pass to shred the Constitution, and hard-working Americans shouldn't be forced to bankroll their own surveillance. I’m so excited to be running for re-election to the United States Senate in New Jersey and we can’t afford to leave anything on the field. During my first race for Newark Municipal Council, we forced a runoff against the party-machine by just a few hundred votes, so I know that we can’t take any vote for granted in an election as critical as the midterms this November.

| | | | JoCasta Zamarripa is a lifelong Milwaukeean, a proud daughter of the city’s south side, and a dedicated public servant who’s never stopped fighting for working people. Born and raised in the very neighborhoods she now represents, JoCasta has spent her life pushing for progress that reflects the realities of everyday Wisconsinites.

[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/sT7_cjotPON?e=8d919f2092&c2id=0bdcb6d83cbc8b2aaf05afb952b88bb7)

She made history as the first Latina and first openly bi member of both the Wisconsin State Legislature and the Milwaukee Common Council. She served ten years in the State Assembly and is now in her second term as Alderperson for Milwaukee’s 8th District, where she’s led major efforts on affordable housing, small business licensing reform, and community development.

In 2025, she was the lead sponsor of the Housing Element Plan, a key step in addressing Milwaukee’s housing crisis by expanding affordable options and preventing displacement. Her approach is practical and persistent—building coalitions, navigating political challenges, and staying rooted in the neighborhoods she serves.

Now, JoCasta is running as a Democrat for Wisconsin Secretary of State to use the platform to fight for what matters: more funding for our schools so families aren’t forced into referenda every election, real housing relief for working people, and affordable child care that lets parents breathe.

Friend, As more people struggle to afford housing and Trump ramps up attacks on unhoused people, **we’ve got to speak up and fight for our neighbors.** Upon returning to Washington, D.C. next week, the Senate will consider and negotiate on the House-passed version of the annual military budget According to the nonprofit Public Citizen, **just one year of our military budget could “house every homeless person in the U.S.****_for_********_121 years_****.”** Congress has the power and resources to end homelessness, but our elected officials’ priorities are shamefully misplaced. They need to hear from us. ****[**Please sign to demand Congress urgently pass policies to end the unhoused crisis, including bills I’ve introduced such as the _Unhoused Persons Bill of Rights, the Youth Homelessness Guaranteed Income Pilot Program Act, and the Tenant Empowerment Act._**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTAaMWCo82TreuofHNKXZ1vsI-8uoczhvCcMB4ZzbYT9Fb3p_I3N4IHUyF51fdCs0NeNjX-INpkw37VkRQc1l4EOuJCp7fHkCjB4p0zBsPEIvgyg1_xG_lxVB1p7rrGT7JEb4q2DoWVe_jEq_dr0YKq0BHfhC2U44JAX04kHoLTyONGFlyTj1hJvxrYn2kfEa8313Gu9T5nQA6syc53X4tCQZjbAGTsUdPji73wIrSbA-VlayZEbsXej3Lm61G8PC0Mip3bjUqXZh88onn_FbFur-Y-lWcSc2M6FYzbDPAvk952E4JR0u6ddxmoAKgwmrBA/4u0/74a7QBu5RVu_wmt6GAL8Zw/h1/h001.jzy58PNIAe4APuGrzJDJzB89GgEx0efEAQ6RmkC2u48) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTAaMWCo82TreuofHNKXZ1vsI-8uoczhvCcMB4ZzbYT9Fb3p_I3N4IHUyF51fdCs0NfCLooTabk0HoD0GCnAuQTY4TMoTi3POrbfyd-29JuEYuGl8e3KXzWvPqv4c5tiAXlEHhNyBbMyWF96mvJ8YXDzdiz8W2zmLyMve4mpZHBSWkwDZ4mG6YlK3YUIGR3epYcOmFBBjHcS5xi54MXo44TX-suLOA_LQ1KITW6UjpqOvLrGZesTOqMjMTNuTnAL16qHLt6bkWsrUrSZeYcy9z-huHPZ-VxlLIEGY7rBQ5sUbcdooGEMBzrGXxHCgi35Rdw/4u0/74a7QBu5RVu_wmt6GAL8Zw/h2/h001.8qFI-GS8li2XVbGWBpLk6_2F8uqz8Jf3zNzgwyjkiiQ)

With housing costs continuing to rapidly outpace wages, homelessness is on the rise.
This crisis is especially urgent as Trump tries to dismantle our fair housing laws and gut the Department of Housing and Urban Development — while regularly talking about wanting to criminalize homelessness and force unhoused people into cruel camps.
To prevent that, I just co-sponsored the******_No Homeless Detention Centers Act_** , which would ban federal dollars from forcing unhoused people into detention-like facilities, ban forced labor at those facilities, and ban the facilities from punishing people for doing basic things they need to survive.
I’ve also passed bills into law that**increase the supply of affordable housing, expand home ownership opportunities** to lower-wealth people, and **help families avoid eviction** by paying their utility bills.
But there’s so much more to do, including investing in home repairs so people can stay in their homes, expanding banking opportunities and access to credit, stopping appraisal bias that devalues Black-owned homes, and ending discriminatory lending and property tax practices that keep widening the wealth gap between Black and white families.
**[Please add your name to tell Congress: In the richest country in the history of the world, it’s time to prevent and eradicate homelessness.](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTAaMWCo82TreuofHNKXZ1vsI-8uoczhvCcMB4ZzbYT9Fb3p_I3N4IHUyF51fdCs0NfZahEwMPn4aYbvudVLolqYvq0jAiKQ2-RvBsFSicHngmAVyWo9mJmb_J2vjuEPg4-NyXfCupaWOHUnhH9jt3hluWubfm36r0RYi5qLcMc4q7MeO21Neoe6-o6vwfv78IwNCizK4lIlZDtKxrx54D_bW5n23hd7f19P672p8BvZ0UhGnwHd9sLAiwQvavzaMYYG0aE7GI8QuazEypenYyV6ArcT1AF2Mdw4GlORN7B88KEvW3MjkLiEdGwlDSdSncg/4u0/74a7QBu5RVu_wmt6GAL8Zw/h3/h001.J1jjMnEhkGx5YpwiBUGMs1cdVujOuKywegRhDQm59jY)**
Thank you for taking action to expand our shared right to housing. Please feel free to read more about the federal dollars I’ve brought to my district to expand access to housing, and other work I’ve done for housing justice.
With you in the fight for justice and dignity for all,
Rashida

Friend,
As housing costs rapidly outpace wages, homelessness is on the rise.
Trump is also gutting enforcement of our housing rights and threatening to lock up our unhoused neighbors. We must speak up!
**Having access to a safe place to live is a human right, and we have the resources to permanently house all Americans in need** — including about 1 million K-12 students who experience homelessness each year.
When the Senate comes back next week, they’ll consider the annual military budget bill. The House-passed version would spend **nearly $1 trillion of our taxpayer dollars on war and weapons corporations**.
The nonprofit group Public Citizen says that **just one year of this budget would “house every homeless person in the U.S.****_for_********_121 years_****.”**
**[Could you sign on to demand Congress eradicate homelessness in the richest country in the history of the world?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTAaMWCo82TreuofHNKXZ1vsI-8uoczhvCcMB4ZzbYT9Fb3p_I3N4IHUyF51fdCs0NZhACn6cQK--cy-FXALz4BYo7DoWapzvwR2cB1Iul1q28NC81V0KktamsUzTxZebuXB2zhav7amul4rFA-PcEViBsGd2i2MXyCEoU8wmrDj4YXq36sWqJEswZRrceOvKIeuQVudv0nrokGEjOL2HcACIldndWGrl0Qm0-3Eg86NmaCbi89NKBqnZP6ai3c25IUDKhXSp2_079M5MCL8p9JFLPs_aapK7ACHyIBhmGvZZSy-j8zaKIXlrDHYFdsao6g/4u0/74a7QBu5RVu_wmt6GAL8Zw/h5/h001.fyu3X9OCzhUK8MIuRzhJg4SnGcAO_w8o4vIGXkeHL7k)**

I’ve passed bills into law that**increase the supply of affordable housing, expand home ownership opportunities** to lower-wealth people, and **help families avoid eviction** by paying their utility bills.
But there’s so much more to do. I’m pushing to **expand banking opportunities and access to credit** , stop appraisal bias that devalues Black-owned homes, and **end discriminatory lending** and property tax practices that keep widening the wealth gap between Black and white families.
And right now, **people in my district need support with home repairs after last week’s storms**. So far, I’ve brought more than $7 million to my district to help seniors and flood victims repair and stay in their homes. I also passed a bill securing $3 billion for home repairs and neighborhood revitalization across the country, but we need to get this funding signed into law.
Here are some urgently-needed policies I’ve introduced, which Congress should pass as soon as possible:
* The **_Youth Homelessness Guaranteed Income Pilot Program Act_**. Young people experiencing homelessness crafted this bill to provide monthly direct cash assistance to young people in need.
* The **_Unhoused Persons Bill of Rights_** , which declares our neighbors’ human rights and provides solutions for the federal government to permanently end the unhoused crisis.
* The **_Tenant Empowerment Act_** , which would strengthen HUD tenant protections and provide renters in public housing with the tools necessary to improve the quality of their homes.
* Last week I also co-sponsored the******_No Homeless Detention Centers Act_** , which would prevent Trump’s threats by banning federal dollars from forcing unhoused people into detention-like facilities, and banning forced labor at such facilities.

**[Please sign to demand Congress prioritize ending the unhoused crisis, including passing legislation like the _Unhoused Persons Bill of Rights, the Youth Homelessness Guaranteed Income Pilot Program Act, the No Homeless Detention Centers Act, and the Tenant Empowerment Act._](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9jzJnep0tjRIZRggydvVqTAaMWCo82TreuofHNKXZ1vsI-8uoczhvCcMB4ZzbYT9Fb3p_I3N4IHUyF51fdCs0Nf7gQI_iGqblHJLaU5RgJDoTAJnJwGxHw5Wv1etdHCxcWfl-CGea3h_thHZeQcbGAFfEcILGLFX_Cw4bu-NwjZvRL91M1OpDa4UhtU0p1o7h0eEtE9DIpTkQ5Xb6eDkZVyvuVIOXeNlcnB4HGUbLhp5G3F3MNKBf2a3jQ30DhINOe0z5lmbjNqL4RWAPs10n2nHBzjj3T4AnNsrjqMa7lX3xSpleOmKSDFNUMF40rb4GqWqzMQK6Bbg8LRYFGI_bMA/4u0/74a7QBu5RVu_wmt6GAL8Zw/h7/h001.ocp7-uJAQ7IgQcvYtsND-iFC2vL0aSOCNNcI2H_-298)**

clean_body: Our unhoused neighbors deserve respect, dignity, safety, and autonomy. | | | Friend, As more people struggle to afford housing and Trump ramps up attacks on unhoused people, we’ve got to speak up and fight for our neighbors. Upon returning to Washington, D.C. next week, the Senate will consider and negotiate on the House-passed version of the annual military budget According to the nonprofit Public Citizen, just one year of our military budget could “house every homeless person in the U.S.for****121 years.” Congress has the power and resources to end homelessness, but our elected officials’ priorities are shamefully misplaced. They need to hear from us. ** | With housing costs continuing to rapidly outpace wages, homelessness is on the rise. This crisis is especially urgent as Trump tries to dismantle our fair housing laws and gut the Department of Housing and Urban Development — while regularly talking about wanting to criminalize homelessness and force unhoused people into cruel camps. To prevent that, I just co-sponsored the**No Homeless Detention Centers Act , which would ban federal dollars from forcing unhoused people into detention-like facilities, ban forced labor at those facilities, and ban the facilities from punishing people for doing basic things they need to survive. I’ve also passed bills into law thatincrease the supply of affordable housing, expand home ownership opportunities to lower-wealth people, and help families avoid eviction by paying their utility bills. But there’s so much more to do, including investing in home repairs so people can stay in their homes, expanding banking opportunities and access to credit, stopping appraisal bias that devalues Black-owned homes, and ending discriminatory lending and property tax practices that keep widening the wealth gap between Black and white families. Thank you for taking action to expand our shared right to housing. Please feel free to read more about the federal dollars I’ve brought to my district to expand access to housing, and other work I’ve done for housing justice. With you in the fight for justice and dignity for all, Rashida ** \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Rashida Tlaib**** Date: Sat, Sept 12, 2026 Subject: Demand Congress end homelessness in the richest country in the history of the world: To: dpwillis67@gmail.com Friend, As housing costs rapidly outpace wages, homelessness is on the rise. So far, I’ve brought more than $7 million to my district to help seniors and flood victims repair and stay in their homes. I also passed a bill securing $3 billion for home repairs and neighborhood revitalization across the country, but we need to get this funding signed into law. Here are some urgently-needed policies I’ve introduced, which Congress should pass as soon as possible: The Youth Homelessness Guaranteed Income Pilot Program Act. Anti-AI activists have spent the last two years telling America that data centers are a crisis. They have organized. They have won.
In the first three months of 2026, local opposition blocked or delayed at least 75 data center projects worth about $130 billion. That is roughly what the whole of 2025 looked like, compressed into one quarter. Active opposition groups more than doubled, to 833, across 49 states.
They did this organizing on phones. On apps. On social networks that would not exist without data centers.
This reminds me of when anti-oil protesters paddled out in boats made of petrochemicals/plastic (a product of oil). The protest required the thing being protested.
Now, you can hate a data center and still refresh the feed that told you to hate it, powered by a data center.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/83262ac2-b6be-415f-9002-2381c3b50dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **Current tech industry leaders got in front of the anti-data-center movement**
Elon Musk's SpaceX /XAI stack, Meta, Anthropic, and the rest of the names already on top have played the anti-AI/anti-data center reactionary activists.
[| | | | | Elon Musk
---
@elonmusk
Dario is right
| | | | | Dario Amodei @DarioAmodei
---|---|---
We Must Pace the Frontier: I've written a new essay on why the AI industry should slow down, with a three-part plan for doing so. Anthropic is unilaterally committing to the first of these steps. We'll provide third-party evaluators with permanent, employee-level access to our
| 3:01 PM * Sep 12, 2026 * 8.47M Views5.37K Replies * 5.12K Reposts * 45.5K Likes
---](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/366dbfc4-9304-4102-824c-36a89f84810c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Reactionary activists want moratoria and guardrails written around practices the current labs already follow. They think they are punching the system but are really just handing permanent control to the same few companies.
When Anthropic endorsed California's SB 53, they wrote that the bill would "formalize practices that Anthropic and many other frontier AI companies already follow." XAI's Colossus campus in Memphis is one of the largest AI supercomputers on earth. Anthropic contracted to take the entire compute load of Colossus 1 -- more than 220,000 GPUs -- while SpaceX talks about expanding AI infrastructure to orbit. Meta keeps pouring concrete. The protest is for the next guy.
Reactionary activists think they are punching up at "the industry." They are really just punching sideways -- at the challenger who does not yet have the means to stand up for themselves.
### **This is older than AI.**
From 1938 to 1978, the Civil Aeronautics Board ran the U.S. airline industry. It set fares. It picked routes. Over those forty years it never certified a single new trunkline carrier to join the sixteen that existed when the law was written. Those sixteen wanted "stability." What they got was a cartel with a government letterhead. When deregulation finally came, consumers got the thing the CAB had spent four decades preventing: competition on price.
New York did the same thing with taxi medallions. From 1937 to 1996 the city added no new licenses. The medallion became a lottery ticket. The public got fewer cabs and higher fares. The people already in the business got an asset they could sell. Uber did not win because it was more virtuous. It won because it went around a permit system designed to make sure nobody new showed up.
Down here on the Gulf Coast we still live in that system. If you want to commercially fish reef fish in federal waters -- red snapper, grouper, and more -- NOAA does not hand you a new permit. The list is capped. The only way in is to buy a limited-access permit from someone who already has one, then buy quota shares that were first handed to the boats that were already there. Grandfathered in or purchased. A kid from Bayou La Batre does not get to compete his way onto the water. He has to wait for an old license to come up for sale and already be in the clique.
Every time an industry becomes a powerful player in our future, it discovers a public-interest story for why the next competitor should have to wait. The Cab Industry called it order. Current tech industry leaders call it safety & alignment on Tuesday and beating China on Thursday.
Sometimes those concerns are real. Pollution is real. Fish stocks are real. Safety is real. The potential for catastrophic misuse is real. However, one truth has been consistent- the rules seem to be written in the way that existing industry leaders can easily comply, and the company that does not exist yet will never be able to.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9reWxlZm9yYWxhYmFtYS5zdWJzdGFjay5jb20vYWNjb3VudCIsInAiOjIxNTUwMDU3MiwicyI6NzMxODY2MSwiZiI6dHJ1ZSwidSI6OTA1MDExOTIsImlhdCI6MTc4OTMxMjc1NiwiZXhwIjoyMTA0ODg4NzU2LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMCIsInN1YiI6ImxpbmstcmVkaXJlY3QifQ.RwRnLChZUfVD_kP_r6ZK5Pb9nMF3vx-E9Vk6Hanxg1A?)
### They are attempting to lock the industry down.
A compute threshold that matches what current tech industry leaders already spend. A moratorium that freezes the map after the big campuses are already permitted. A "safety" standard that is, in the authors' own words, a formalization of practices the authors already use.
If your rule makes it illegal, or merely impossible, to challenge industry leaders on the only infrastructure that matters, you did not protect workers. You did not protect the planet. You did not beat China. You protected current tech industry leaders. You made compute a rigged commercial fishing license for a select few.
Anti-AI/anti-data center activists were played. Industry control might very well end up going where it was always going to go- into the hands of the people who already had it.
We should not be against data centers. We should be against a country where only a handful of companies are allowed to have them.
Cheaper goods. More choice. Businesses that can actually compete. That includes compute.
-- Kyle

Current tech industry leaders took that energy and plan to turn it into a wall. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Activists organized the protests on phones that only exist because of data centers. Current tech industry leaders took that energy and plan to turn it into a wall. | | | Sep 13 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- Anti-AI activists have spent the last two years telling America that data centers are a crisis. They have organized. They have won. In the first three months of 2026, local opposition blocked or delayed at least 75 data center projects worth about $130 billion. That is roughly what the whole of 2025 looked like, compressed into one quarter. Active opposition groups more than doubled, to 833, across 49 states. They did this organizing on phones. On apps. On social networks that would not exist without data centers. This reminds me of when anti-oil protesters paddled out in boats made of petrochemicals/plastic (a product of oil). The protest required the thing being protested. Now, you can hate a data center and still refresh the feed that told you to hate it, powered by a data center. | | ---|---|--- Current tech industry leaders got in front of the anti-data-center movement Elon Musk's SpaceX /XAI stack, Meta, Anthropic, and the rest of the names already on top have played the anti-AI/anti-data center reactionary activists. Reactionary activists want moratoria and guardrails written around practices the current labs already follow. They think they are punching the system but are really just handing permanent control to the same few companies. When Anthropic endorsed California's SB 53, they wrote that the bill would "formalize practices that Anthropic and many other frontier AI companies already follow." XAI's Colossus campus in Memphis is one of the largest AI supercomputers on earth. Anthropic contracted to take the entire compute load of Colossus 1 -- more than 220,000 GPUs -- while SpaceX talks about expanding AI infrastructure to orbit. Meta keeps pouring concrete. The protest is for the next guy. Reactionary activists think they are punching up at "the industry." They are really just punching sideways -- at the challenger who does not yet have the means to stand up for themselves. This is older than AI. From 1938 to 1978, the Civil Aeronautics Board ran the U.S. airline industry. It set fares. It picked routes. Over those forty years it never certified a single new trunkline carrier to join the sixteen that existed when the law was written. Those sixteen wanted "stability." What they got was a cartel with a government letterhead. When deregulation finally came, consumers got the thing the CAB had spent four decades preventing: competition on price. New York did the same thing with taxi medallions. From 1937 to 1996 the city added no new licenses. The medallion became a lottery ticket. The public got fewer cabs and higher fares. The people already in the business got an asset they could sell. Uber did not win because it was more virtuous. It won because it went around a permit system designed to make sure nobody new showed up. Down here on the Gulf Coast we still live in that system. If you want to commercially fish reef fish in federal waters -- red snapper, grouper, and more -- NOAA does not hand you a new permit. The list is capped. The only way in is to buy a limited-access permit from someone who already has one, then buy quota shares that were first handed to the boats that were already there. Grandfathered in or purchased. A kid from Bayou La Batre does not get to compete his way onto the water. He has to wait for an old license to come up for sale and already be in the clique. Every time an industry becomes a powerful player in our future, it discovers a public-interest story for why the next competitor should have to wait. The Cab Industry called it order. Current tech industry leaders call it safety & alignment on Tuesday and beating China on Thursday. Sometimes those concerns are real. Pollution is real. Fish stocks are real. Safety is real. The potential for catastrophic misuse is real. However, one truth has been consistent- the rules seem to be written in the way that existing industry leaders can easily comply, and the company that does not exist yet will never be able to. ? They are attempting to lock the industry down. A compute threshold that matches what current tech industry leaders already spend. A moratorium that freezes the map after the big campuses are already permitted. A "safety" standard that is, in the authors' own words, a formalization of practices the authors already use. If your rule makes it illegal, or merely impossible, to challenge industry leaders on the only infrastructure that matters, you did not protect workers. You did not protect the planet. You did not beat China. You protected current tech industry leaders. You made compute a rigged commercial fishing license for a select few. Anti-AI/anti-data center activists were played. Industry control might very well end up going where it was always going to go- into the hands of the people who already had it. We should not be against data centers. We should be against a country where only a handful of companies are allowed to have them. Cheaper goods. More choice. Businesses that can actually compete. That includes compute. -- Kyle ? | | | | | | | (C) 2026 Kyle Sweetser 548 Market Street PMB 72296, San Francisco, CA 94104 ? ?
